description.value: Meares Vista Inn is a family-owned and operated motel on Campbell Street in Tofino, open since 2012 and self-described as 'simply clean and comfortable.' It offers four room configurations — Single Queen, Queen Suite, Upper Double Queen, and Lower Double Queen — and bills itself as an unpretentious, relaxed base for exploring Tofino's beaches and surrounding coastal wilderness. The owners also support local staff by providing space for RV living on the property.

address.value: 760 Campbell Street, Tofino, BC, V0R 2Z0, Canada
